Problem Statement:
Write a program to check if an expression contains duplicate brackets using a stack.
An expression has duplicate brackets if there are multiple brackets enclosing nothing. 
Input Description:
A single string expression containing brackets and characters. 
Output Description:
true or false 
Sample Input:
((a+b)+((c+d))) 
Sample Output:
true
